mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_poster (poster_id, user_id, template, range_json, image_url, thumb_url, share_token, idempotency_key, status, expires_at, generated_at) VALUES (#{posterId}, #{userId}, #{template}, #{rangeJson}, #{imageUrl}, #{thumbUrl}, #{shareToken}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{generatedAt})
